description: This file defines a PHP class 'mbinfo' that interfaces with system sensors to retrieve temperature, fan speed, and voltage data. It includes methods to parse output from the 'sensors' command for hardware monitoring purposes.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving hardware sensor data such as temperatures, fans, and voltages by parsing output from system 'sensors' command.

methods.name: mbinfo
methods.description: Constructor that executes the 'sensors' command and processes the output lines for further analysis.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Parses sensor output lines to extract temperature readings with labels and values.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Parses sensor output lines to extract fan speed readings.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Parses sensor output lines to extract voltage readings.
